gaps.what: The Dubai Building Code's default setbacks by number of floors (Table B.1), which apply only where the affection plan or DCR sets none
gaps.why: Plotwise takes every setback from the affection plan as you enter it; it applies no default of its own

gaps.what: Development control regulations (DCR) and master-developer guidelines beyond the affection plan
gaps.why: They vary by community and are not published in one place; check them with the master developer and the permitting authority
